# vulnetix_virtual_patches (Data Source)

The Vulnetix generated virtual patches in one detection rule feed: its entries whose `rule_table` is `virtual_patch`. Third-party catalogue rules and countermeasures in the same feed are left out. Feeds need a Pro plan or higher.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "vulnetix_virtual_patches" "waf" {
  feed_name = "edge-waf"
}

output "patched_cves" {
  value = distinct([for p in data.vulnetix_virtual_patches.waf.patches : p.matched_cve if p.matched_cve != ""])
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `feed_name` (String) The feed's name. Set this or `feed_uuid`; it must match exactly one feed.
- `feed_uuid` (String) The feed's id. Set this or `feed_name`.
- `include_disabled` (Boolean) Also return entries that are disabled, and so left out of the published feed. Defaults to false.

### Read-Only

- `feed_type` (String) The feed's output format, such as `MODSECURITY` or `AWS_WAF`.
- `manifest_url` (String) The published feed's `manifest.json`.
- `patches` (Attributes List) The virtual patch entries. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--patches))
- `public_base_url` (String) Where the published files are served from.
- `status` (String) `DRAFT`, `PUBLISHED` or `REVOKED`.

<a id="nestedatt--patches"></a>
### Nested Schema for `patches`

Read-Only:

- `added_at` (Number) When the entry was added, in Unix milliseconds.
- `disabled` (Boolean) Whether the entry is left out of the published feed.
- `id` (Number) The entry's id within the feed.
- `matched_cve` (String) The vulnerability the rule was added for, when known.
- `rule_name` (String) The rule's name.
- `rule_source` (String) The rule's source, when known.
- `rule_table` (String) Where the rule comes from: `snort_rule`, `yara_rule`, `virtual_patch` or `countermeasure`.
- `rule_type` (String) The rule's format, such as `SURICATA` or `SIGMA`.
- `rule_uuid` (String) The rule's id in its table.
